nina: Quick note: noticed onboarding sampleapp (node) sometimes logs a different request-id than the OTEL span when DEBUG logging is on. suspecting race during SDK autoinit + middleware retry wrapper.

nina: Quick repro I used locally:
```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/sampleapp.git
cd sampleapp/examples/node
npm ci
REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug node server.js
# call /chat a few times with a client that retries once
```
Logs show initial incoming request-id, then retry wrapper sets a new id, but span.start has the original id until sdk finishes init and "reconciles" it, resulting in mismatch in logs vs traces.

sam: thanks for the repro. can you paste the minimal log lines + sdk versions? Also does this happen with our electron sample or just the express example?

nina: log snippet:
```
[2026-04-07T10:01:11.000Z] INFO  http  <-- GET /chat { request-id: "rid-100" }
[2026-04-07T10:01:11.005Z] DEBUG retry assigning new request-id: "rid-200"
[2026-04-07T10:01:11.008Z] DEBUG otel span.start trace=tr-1 request-id=rid-100
[2026-04-07T10:01:11.015Z] DEBUG sdk  init complete; request-id reconciled -> rid-200
```
Packages: redwood-telemetry@0.9.2, redwood-sdk@1.4.2, @opentelemetry/api@1.1.0, node v20.x

oliver: i hit a similar one in a quickstart where we lazily init telemetry if level==debug. workaround was to call require('redwood-telemetry').init({forceSync:true}) early but that defeats some debug-only hooks.

sam: implementation suggestion: during init, check req.headers for x-request-id/request-id and if present copy into a stable slot (eg. req._rw_orig_rid). when creating spans prefer that value. also add a unit test that simulates early middleware changing headers before init. low risk.

nina: +1. also add a telemetry counter metric telemetry.requestid.reconciled to monitor in hosted. would like a changelog blurb too.

dev-telemetry-bot: created issue #4601: "preserve existing request-id across deferred init paths" assigned to @oliver. staging redeploy scheduled for validation.

oliver: i'll draft the patch: 1) stash header during init, 2) prefer stash when building span context, 3) add test and changelog note. i'll ping for review when ready.

nina: thanks! this will help reduce confusion for new users hitting sampleapps during onboarding :thumbsup:
